comment: Issue #4633: justified per-test-name parity differences for the repo self-migration gate. Kinds: missing / extra (one exact display name, optional count), rows (one theory method whose rows render differently, paired by argument names) and renamed-argument (one theory method whose parameter is renamed; rows must otherwise match exactly). 'reason' and 'issue' are mandatory; unused entries are reported as stale. Seeded from branch nightly 36948633989: every entry cites the P0 self-migration bug that causes it. Rules: tools/cs2gs/README.md, 'Per-test-name parity'.
